info.title: Aivoryx Platform API
info.description: Code-first OpenAPI contract. Regenerate with `pnpm contracts:generate`.

cookie.name: aivoryx_session
cookie.description: HTTP-only session cookie (ADR 0010). Set by the auth endpoints in Phase 2.

displayName.description: Workspace display name for the app shell.

primaryColor.description: Validated 6-digit hex primary brand colour, or null for the Aivoryx default.

hasLogo.description: True when the workspace has uploaded a logo.

permissions.description: Permission keys granted in this tenant.

roles.description: Role keys held in this tenant.

branding.description: Safe tenant branding for the app shell (never a security boundary).

active.description: Null until the session has a usable active tenant.

tenantAutoSelected.description: True when the single-membership user was auto-selected into a tenant.

active.description: Null until the session has a usable active tenant.

membershipId.description: A membership id belonging to the current user.

active.description: Null until the session has a usable active tenant.

workspaceName.description: The workspace name (from the tenant record).

hasLogo.description: True when a primary logo is configured.

href.description: App path to complete this step, if the caller can access it.

complete.description: True once every visible step is done.

dismissed.description: True once an admin has dismissed the checklist.

show.description: True when the checklist should be shown to this user right now.

actorName.description: Display name of the actor membership.
Display name of the actor membership.

changes.description: Sanitised before/after for approved fields: `{ field: { from, to } }`.

invitationPending.description: True while an invitation for this membership is still pending.

token.description: One-time invitation token. Returned ONLY here (no email provider is configured); relay it to the invitee out of band.
The one-time token from the invitation link.

password.description: Required only when the invited account has no password yet.

customFields.description: Tenant custom-field values, keyed by field key.

origin.description: Provenance. The field app sets "field_agent"; omit for a normal CRM-created lead.

entity.description: Which entity this field belongs to — "visit" defines a site-survey question (ADR 0033).

fieldMapping.description: Provider field -> "canonical:<field>" | "custom:<key>" | "skip" overrides, merged over the built-in defaults.

secret.description: One-time connector secret. Returned ONLY here (create / rotate); send it to Pabbly as the "Authorization: Bearer <secret>" header. Never returned again.

siteLat.description: Known site latitude — no geocoding is performed.

siteLng.description: Known site longitude — no geocoding is performed.

values.description: Survey field values, keyed by the visit custom-field key.

distanceKm.description: Mileage evidence in km — used only if the category has a mileage rate.

value.description: New value (string; ISO datetime for time fields).

amount.description: Signed amount to add to the balance ledger.

availableBalance.description: The requester’s current balance for this leave type.

employeeId.description: HR/managers only — omit for a self-service request.

defaultMileageRate.description: Set to make this a mileage category (distance × rate).

projectRef.description: Soft reference to a project (no FK).

visitRef.description: Soft reference to a field visit (no FK).

status.description: Set with FAILED to record a failed reimbursement.

idempotencyKey.description: Retry key — a repeated call with the same key is a no-op.

delta.description: Signed decimal string — the on-hand delta.

idempotencyKey.description: Retry key — a repeated call with the same key returns the same receipt.

lines.description: Per-line delivered quantities; omit to accept every line in full.

description.description: Line description. Required for service/custom lines; defaults to the product name.

idempotencyKey.description: Retry key — a repeated booking with the same key is a no-op.

allocations.description: Optional: allocate the payment to these invoices in the same request.
